name: pulser audio
changelog:
• Zero-Crash Linux AppImage Restart: Built-in sandbox wrapper prevents setuid sandbox aborts on Ubuntu 24.04 and modern Linux distros
• Canonical In-Place Auto-Updating: Linux AppImage updates in-place seamlessly without broken paths
• Self-Healing Desktop Shortcuts: Automatically updates ~/.local/share/applications/pulsar-music-player.desktop and launcher
• Fast Differential Windows Auto-Updates: Differential .blockmap metadata for instant updates
• Exact Song Click & Name Matching: 100% matched song playback and offline shuffle queue preservation
• Zero Root Password Prompts: Completely user-space updates
